economicMagnitude.caveat: Arithmetic event attribution is not a compounded portfolio counterfactual; group shares are unstable when net contribution is near zero.

candidateMechanisms.evidence: Rank gap Spearman and score-spread Spearman are near zero; bucket results are non-monotonic.
Small rank-gap swaps have positive mean advantage rather than systematic harm.
Incoming 20-session strength is non-monotonic and its continuous relationship is near zero.
Unprofitable and near-MAE incumbents show better replacement economics, but intervals cross zero and the familywise null is unsupportive.
No predeclared continuous feature exceeds ordinary strongest-relationship behavior under clustered null calibration.

candidateMechanism: No simple PIT replacement feature cleared the combined interpretability, materiality, independent-cluster, tail-concentration, and familywise null-calibration standard.
conclusion: No simple PIT replacement feature cleared the combined interpretability, materiality, independent-cluster, tail-concentration, and familywise null-calibration standard.
recommendation: No narrow replacement modification is currently justified.
